claims.claim: US used Sigma 12-24 mm lens for Canon camera.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black Sigma-style wide lens with ribbed rings and a hood, but the exact brand/model text and the mount/compatibility (Canon) are not clearly readable.

claims.claim: The lens looks new and in perfect working condition.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show glass condition details (scratches/fungus/haze/oil) or functional proof (autofocus/aperture/image stabilization).

risks.risk: Wrong mount/compatibility (e.g., not actually Canon mount, or not the claimed Sigma 12-24 variant).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the mount side showing the exact mount marking (Canon EF/EF-S) and the full model/part number on the barrel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used wide-angle lens with unknown mount/compatibility (buyer risk of mismatch).

risks.risk: Lens may have hidden optical issues (fungus, haze, oil, scratches) not visible in the provided close-ups.
risks.proof: A photo of the lens glass against a bright light from multiple angles, plus a close-up of the front and rear elements for surface defects.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-fully-verified optical condition (assume possible wear).

risks.risk: Functionality not proven (autofocus/aperture control/IS if present).
risks.proof: A short video showing autofocus operation and aperture changes on a compatible camera body (or a test shot showing focus accuracy).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (front/rear caps, filter, hood condition, box/pouch) affecting usability and resale value.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included items laid out (front cap, rear cap, hood, any filters, pouch/box) with condition visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing some or all standard accessories.

risks.risk: Model/region mismatch (the claim 'US used' may not match the actual variant/part number).
risks.proof: A clear shot of the full model/part number and any region/serial markings on the lens barrel.
risks.if_unproven: Price without relying on the region/variant claim.

proof_requests: Clear, readable photo of the lens brand/model and part number on the barrel (not just partial text).
Photo of the mount side showing the exact mount type (Canon EF/EF-S) and any compatibility markings.
Front and rear element photos against strong light to check for fungus/haze/oil/scratches.
Short video or test photos showing autofocus and aperture behavior on a Canon body (or a camera-compatible demonstration).
Photos of all included accessories: front cap, rear cap, lens hood, any filters, and whether there is a box/pouch.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a camera lens with a hood, but the exact Sigma 12-24 model and Canon mount are not readable, and working/optical condition is not proven by photos. Without these, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
